lines.zh: 我左右摇着走，脚掌拍水。
lines.en: I waddle left and right, feet slapping the water.

lines.zh: 河岸边泥软，我踩出一排印。
lines.en: The riverbank is soft; I leave a row of prints.

lines.zh: 我一下水，摇步就没了。
lines.en: Once in the water, my waddle disappears.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水浑，我照样游。
lines.en: The swamp water is murky and I swim it anyway.

lines.zh: 我从芦苇里挤过去，羽毛沾水。
lines.en: I squeeze through reeds with wet feathers.

lines.zh: 我走在鸭队最后，谁也不等。
lines.en: I walk at the back of the line; nobody waits.

lines.zh: 我脚掌踩草，走到河边就停。
lines.en: I cross the grass and stop at the water's edge.

lines.zh: 我的影子在水底跟着我游。
lines.en: My shadow swims along the riverbed beneath me.

lines.zh: 我一步一摆，走进浅滩。
lines.en: One step, one wobble, into the shallows.

lines.zh: 岸太滑，我改用翅膀撑。
lines.en: The bank is slippery, so I brace with a wing.

lines.zh: 我沿着河走，找浮萍。
lines.en: I follow the river, looking for duckweed.

lines.zh: 后面的鸭子挤我，我不理它。
lines.en: A duck behind shoves me; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我小跑几步，水面跟着响。
lines.en: I scurry a few steps and the water answers.

lines.zh: 我走过泥地，尾巴一翘一翘。
lines.en: Across the mud I go, tail bobbing up and down.

lines.zh: 我摆着屁股上岸，水顺着羽毛流。
lines.en: I waddle ashore, water running off my feathers.

lines.zh: 河湾的鸭子排成一列，我在中间。
lines.en: The ducks form a line along the bend, and I am in the middle.

lines.zh: 我把头缩进翅膀，只留一只眼。
lines.en: I tuck my head in a wing, one eye out.

lines.zh: 四点生命，也值得晒一下午太阳。
lines.en: Four points of life is worth an afternoon of sun.

lines.zh: 我在水面上漂着，不用划。
lines.en: I float on the water without paddling.

lines.zh: 沼泽上有蚊子，我一口一只。
lines.en: Mosquitoes over the swamp, and I eat them one by one.

lines.zh: 羽毛理了又乱，我接着理。
lines.en: My feathers rumple again; I keep preening.

lines.zh: 我缩着脖子，等水面平静。
lines.en: I draw my neck in and wait for still water.

lines.zh: 鸭蛋在我身下，还温着。
lines.en: The duck egg beneath me is still warm.

lines.zh: 我叫两声，没人应，就算了。
lines.en: I quack twice, get no answer, and stop.

lines.zh: 太阳照在背上，我眯起眼。
lines.en: Sun on my back, I narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 我在浅水站着，脚掌陷进泥。
lines.en: I stand in shallows, feet sunk in mud.

lines.zh: 风把浮萍吹开，我又推回来。
lines.en: Wind pushes the duckweed away; I nudge it back.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖水，羽毛全炸开。
lines.en: I shake the water off and my feathers puff out.

lines.zh: 一只青蛙在旁边，我们谁都不动。
lines.en: A frog sits nearby; neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我张嘴打哈欠，发出细小的声。
lines.en: I yawn, and a tiny sound comes out.

lines.zh: 我把嘴插进翅膀里，眯了一会儿。
lines.en: I tuck my bill into my feathers and doze a while.

lines.zh: 鸭蛋边上，我一直没挪开。
lines.en: I have not moved from beside the eggs.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边，我歪头看你。
lines.en: You stand on the bank; I tilt my head at you.

lines.zh: 你手里有面包屑，我看见了。
lines.en: You have bread crumbs; I have noticed.

lines.zh: 我带你看河里的浮萍。
lines.en: I could show you the duckweed in the river.

lines.zh: 你的影子进了水，我的羽毛竖起来。
lines.en: Your shadow enters the water and my feathers rise.

lines.zh: 我一只眼盯你，另一只看鱼。
lines.en: One eye on you, the other on the fish.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就往前游一点。
lines.en: You crouch down, so I paddle a bit closer.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩过沼泽，我闻得出来。
lines.en: Your boots have crossed this swamp; I can tell.

lines.zh: 你走得太快，我往芦苇里退。
lines.en: You move too fast, so I back into the reeds.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，你听得见那声嘎吗？
lines.en: I open my bill; did you hear that quack?

lines.zh: 你袖口沾着沼泽的泥，我不怕。
lines.en: Your cuff has swamp mud; I am not afraid.

lines.zh: 你在这岸，我在水里，先看谁动。
lines.en: You on the bank, me in the water; who moves first?

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，把水甩到你身上。
lines.en: I shake my head and fling water onto you.

lines.zh: 我嘎得跑了调，飞起来半格。
lines.en: My quack cracks and I flutter half a block up.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了三根，飘在水上。
lines.en: Three feathers fall and float on the water.

lines.zh: 四点生命，一下就少了一半。
lines.en: Four points of life, and half is gone at once.

lines.zh: 我钻进芦苇，血味留在后面。
lines.en: I dive into the reeds, leaving the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 翅膀一歪，我落回了泥里。
lines.en: One wing tilts and I drop back into mud.

lines.zh: 你打偏了，只擦到我的尾羽。
lines.en: You miss and only graze my tail feathers.

lines.zh: 水花溅起来，我趁机潜下去。
lines.en: Water splashes up and I slip beneath it.

lines.zh: 我疼得直叫，叫声惊动整群鸭。
lines.en: I cry out and the whole flock starts.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记着你的靴子。
lines.en: For this, I remember your boots.

lines.zh: 我还能游，就还没事。
lines.en: If I can still swim, I am fine.

lines.zh: 面包一掰开，我就游过来了。
lines.en: Break the bread and I swim right over.

lines.zh: 你撒一把种子，我全吃了。
lines.en: Scatter a handful of seeds; I eat every one.

lines.zh: 我追着面包屑，游出半个河湾。
lines.en: I chase bread crumbs half a river bend.

lines.zh: 别把面包举太高，我够不着。
lines.en: Do not hold the bread too high; I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我上岸，只为你手里的那点食。
lines.en: I come ashore only for what you hold.

lines.zh: 你手里有食，我就踩着水跟上。
lines.en: Food in your hand, and I paddle after you.

lines.zh: 水里漂的面包，我先抢到。
lines.en: The bread floating there is mine first.

lines.zh: 我咬你指尖，是抢食不是咬人。
lines.en: I nip your fingertip for food, not for spite.

lines.zh: 种子撒进沼泽，我不管泥。
lines.en: Seeds fall into the swamp; I ignore the mud.

lines.zh: 你手心一开，我的脖子就伸长了。
lines.en: Your palm opens and my neck stretches out.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走三步，为了第四步。
lines.en: I follow you three steps, hoping for the fourth.

lines.zh: 吃完了我就走，游回芦苇。
lines.en: When I finish, I leave and swim back to the reeds.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西掉水里，我更快。
lines.en: Drop it in the water and I am faster.

lines.zh: 我嘎一声，是催你快点。
lines.en: I quack, which means hurry up.

lines.zh: 你拍手，我就当你在撒食。
lines.en: When you clap, I assume you are scattering food.

lines.zh: 水里的面包我不急着抢，先看看。
lines.en: I do not rush for the bread in the water; I look first.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的靴子，弹回去。
lines.en: I bump your boot and bounce back.

lines.zh: 我身板小，你还是被绊了一下。
lines.en: I am small, yet you still stumble.

lines.zh: 你踩到我脚掌，我嘎了一声。
lines.en: You step on my foot and I quack.

lines.zh: 水面被我扑腾得全是波纹。
lines.en: My flapping turns the water into ripples.

lines.zh: 别推，我四点生命经不起。
lines.en: Do not push; four points of life is fragile.

lines.zh: 我从你腿间穿过去，翅膀扫到你。
lines.en: I slip between your legs, wing brushing you.

lines.zh: 你退开时，踩塌了我的泥窝。
lines.en: Stepping back, you crush my mud nest.

lines.zh: 我撞你，更像是在催路。
lines.en: When I bump you, I am asking for the path.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我掉了几根羽毛。
lines.en: We collide and I lose a few feathers.

lines.zh: 我甩干羽毛，水溅了你一脸。
lines.en: I shake dry and splash water on your face.

lines.zh: 我在她面前点头，脖子一伸一缩。
lines.en: I bob my head at her, neck pumping.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，翅膀偶尔碰一下。
lines.en: We swim side by side, wings touching now and then.

lines.zh: 芦苇深处有我们的窝。
lines.en: Our nest is deep in the reeds.

lines.zh: 她走前，我跟后，中间隔一只鸭。
lines.en: She leads, I follow, one duck-length behind.

lines.zh: 我把最好的浮萍推给她。
lines.en: I push the best duckweed toward her.

lines.zh: 两只鸭叫成一片，水都响了。
lines.en: Two ducks quack at once and the water rings.

lines.zh: 我们守在蛋边，谁也不下水。
lines.en: We guard the eggs and neither of us swims.

lines.zh: 她用喙理我的背，我一动不动。
lines.en: She preens my back with her bill; I stay still.

lines.zh: 春天里，河湾全是鸭。
lines.en: In spring the river bend is full of ducks.

lines.zh: 她游开，我隔着水面看她。
lines.en: She swims off and I watch her across the water.

lines.zh: 我用喙叼起一根草，掉了。
lines.en: I pick up a grass blade; it falls.

lines.zh: 面包屑在水上，我一嘴捞起。
lines.en: Bread crumbs on the water, I scoop them up.

lines.zh: 我衔着芦苇，拖回窝里。
lines.en: I carry reed in my bill back to the nest.

lines.zh: 那块铁片我含不住。
lines.en: That iron scrap is too much for my bill.

lines.zh: 我把蛋边的碎草往中间推。
lines.en: I push loose grass toward the eggs.

lines.zh: 你扔下的种子，我用喙一颗颗捡。
lines.en: The seeds you drop, I pick up one by one.

lines.zh: 水草缠在脚上，我甩掉了。
lines.en: Weed tangles my foot; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我的喙只能夹小的东西。
lines.en: My bill can only pinch small things.

lines.zh: 那根羽毛是我自己的，不捡。
lines.en: That feather is mine already; I leave it.

lines.zh: 我把面包藏进芦苇根下。
lines.en: I hide the bread under the reed roots.

lines.zh: 你伸手抓我，我才转头。
lines.en: Only when you reach for me do I turn.

lines.zh: 我看出你脚步变了，先退。
lines.en: Your steps changed; I back away first.

lines.zh: 四点的命，我从不硬碰。
lines.en: With four points of life, I never fight head on.

lines.zh: 你太快了，我往水里跑。
lines.en: You are too fast, so I run for the water.

lines.zh: 水面是我的路，你追不上。
lines.en: The water is my road; you cannot follow.

lines.zh: 我把脖子压低，准备钻芦苇。
lines.en: I lower my neck, ready to dive into reeds.

lines.zh: 你踩碎树枝，我就知道你在。
lines.en: You snap a twig and I know where you are.

lines.zh: 我不是对手，但我会躲。
lines.en: I am no fighter, but I am good at hiding.

lines.zh: 一只鸭抬头，整群都抬头。
lines.en: One duck looks up and the whole flock does.

lines.zh: 你要抓，我就先叫一声。
lines.en: If you grab, I quack first.

lines.zh: 我在水面上绕圈，离你八格。
lines.en: I circle on the water, eight blocks from you.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我游两步。
lines.en: You take one step; I paddle two.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，不盯眼睛。
lines.en: I watch your hands, never your eyes.

lines.zh: 芦苇缝里，我只看得到你半张脸。
lines.en: Through the reeds I see only half your face.

lines.zh: 你停，我也停，水面只剩波纹。
lines.en: You stop; I stop; only ripples remain.

lines.zh: 我游到对岸，又回头看。
lines.en: I swim to the far bank and look back.

lines.zh: 你靠岸，我就往河心退。
lines.en: You near the bank and I retreat to midstream.

lines.zh: 鸭子不急，急的是你。
lines.en: The duck is calm; it is you who hurries.

lines.zh: 我让水草挡在中间。
lines.en: I let the waterweed stand between us.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我整只沉下去。
lines.en: You raise a hand and I sink down whole.

lines.zh: 我啄你脚踝，一下就跑。
lines.en: I peck your ankle once and run.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍在你膝盖上，很轻。
lines.en: My wing slaps your knee, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我的攻击连半颗心都不到。
lines.en: My attack does not even take half a heart.

lines.zh: 啄完我就退回水里。
lines.en: After pecking, I retreat to the water.

lines.zh: 你逼到窝边，我才敢还嘴。
lines.en: Only at my nest do I dare fight back.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的鞋带不松。
lines.en: I bite your shoelace and hold on.

lines.zh: 嘎嘎叫着扑上去，其实很怕。
lines.en: I charge quacking, though I am terrified.

lines.zh: 这一啄，是为了护蛋。
lines.en: This peck is for the eggs.

lines.zh: 我扑腾翅膀，把你往后赶。
lines.en: I beat my wings to drive you back.

lines.zh: 我伤不了你，只想让你走开。
lines.en: I cannot hurt you; I only want you gone.

lines.zh: 我从河湾的水草里钻出来。
lines.en: I emerge from the waterweed of the river bend.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾还没散，我已经在了。
lines.en: The swamp fog has not lifted and I am here.

lines.zh: 四点生命，够我游一整天。
lines.en: Four points of life is enough for a day of swimming.

lines.zh: 芦苇响了一下，我就在那里。
lines.en: The reeds rustle once and there I am.

lines.zh: 我跟在别的鸭后面，走进平原。
lines.en: I follow other ducks out into the plains.

lines.zh: 水面开了个圈，我浮上来。
lines.en: A ring opens on the water and I surface.

lines.zh: 岸边的泥还湿，我踩上去。
lines.en: The bank mud is still wet when I step on it.

lines.zh: 天色刚亮，鸭子就成群了。
lines.en: At first light the ducks are already gathered.

lines.zh: 我在浅滩落脚，先理羽毛。
lines.en: I land in the shallows and preen first.

lines.zh: 一声嘎，把整条河叫醒了。
lines.en: One quack wakes the whole river.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的羽毛就卷起来。
lines.en: Fire comes close and my feathers curl.

lines.zh: 从半空掉下来，我摔进浅水。
lines.en: I drop from the air into shallow water.

lines.zh: 水太深，我的羽毛全湿透了。
lines.en: The water is too deep and my feathers are soaked.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到对岸，蛋还在窝里。
lines.en: The blast throws me across the river; eggs stay behind.

lines.zh: 箭擦过脖子，我贴着水面飞。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my neck; I skim the water.

lines.zh: 药水味一冲，我分不清方向。
lines.en: The potion smell hits and I lose direction.

lines.zh: 水里全是浮萍，我却没力气游。
lines.en: Duckweed everywhere, and I cannot paddle to it.

lines.zh: 雷声把我吓得扎进泥里。
lines.en: Thunder scares me flat into the mud.

lines.zh: 掉下去时，我还想找水面。
lines.en: Falling, I still look for water below.
